description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which provides a contract for logging components to implement a method for outputting log data. It includes documentation explaining the purpose of the logging chain and a method signature for logging messages with different priorities, tags, messages, and optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface representing a logging node that outputs log data. It defines a method 'println' for outputting log messages of various priorities, with optional exception information.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
